bundle.shortDescription: Windows security and storage intelligence workstation
bundle.longDescription: C.U.R.E inspects a Windows machine for persistence, suspicious activity and reclaimable storage, and reports what it found with the evidence attached. It never changes anything without an explicit, previewed confirmation.
